574-7084-7889.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a 2/2 green Bear creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-7084-7889.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2023-4289-4770-4927.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4499-6458-8160.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
4499-6458-8160.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2852-4695-8089.description:
Activate Doom Whisperer by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

5777-6692-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
5777-6692-7810.description:
Activate Wicked Wolf by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Wicked Wolf ability
Repeat.

957-7722-7843.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one
Move to your first extra turn.
Blink Thor using Elrond.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your second extra turn.
Cast Time Stretch from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

4872-7370-7487.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Zealous Lorecaster.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Zealous Lorecaster from exile to the battlefield.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4613-7807.description:
Activate Dr. Beverly Crusher by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Dr. Beverly Crusher triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2781-3375-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1116-1580-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-206-1409-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

670-1619-3991-6152.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3991-6152.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, it triggers, returning Veteran Dungeoneer from exile to the battlefield.
When Veteran Dungeoneer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Veteran Dungeoneer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Veteran Dungeoneer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-2511-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
1123-2511-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

640-3033-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-3033-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Vengeful Vampire.
Vengeful Vampire dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Vengeful Vampire trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Vengeful Vampire, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

1993-3259-3861--85--106.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
1993-3259-3861--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1993-3259-3861--85--106.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1395-3713-3755-5078.description:
Activate Steelfin Whale by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

1510-2292-4574-5849.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1887-2734-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-3200-5295.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

132-1978-6893.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
132-1978-6893.description:
Activate Myr Welder using The Eternity Elevator's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
132-1978-6893.notes: If The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it, you can instead use its second ability to get infinite colored mana. You can also use both interchangeably, if desired.

1987-4423-6700-6918.easyPrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
You control three additional Islands.
1987-4423-6700-6918.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome.
When Sarevok's Tome enters, it triggers, causing you to take the initiative.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

659-4381-4613-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-4785.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

7-1020-3689-6518.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
7-1020-3689-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-1669-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5551-5686.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-5551-5686.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 4.

333-997-4775.notablePrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-997-4775.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

224-1525-2907-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-2907-4913.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and each Scute Swarm you control trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

1744-3334-3487-5770.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Aetherstorm Roc.
When the Aetherstorm Roc tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers five times, causing you to get 60 {E}.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

671-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
671-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1379-1558-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Angel" chosen with Conspiracy.
1379-1558-4302-4875.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Angels due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers five times.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability from step 1, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1304-1669-4679.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature, artifact, or land that can produce at least {2}.
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
1304-1669-4679.description:
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Nature's Chosen attached to Yenna, untapping Yenna, and scrying 2.
Activate the Nature's Chosen token's second ability by tapping Yenna, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate the Nature's Chosen token's first ability by paying {0}, untapping Yenna.
Activate Thaumatog's second ability by sacrificing the Nature's Chosen token, causing Thaumatog to get +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
If the mana-producing permanent can produce at least {3}, this combo produces infinite mana that artifacts, creatures, and lands you control can produce.

803-1821-3698-3764.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
When the Pincher enters the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Arcane Adaptation, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token.
When the Incubator enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Incubator.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.
